posts.text:
People use the term "digital sovereignty" to mean a lot of different things. At EFF, we think digital sovereignty should be an opportunity for users around the world to build more resilient, open  systems and the skills and infrastructure to maintain them. 

www.eff.org/deeplinks/20...
